data.rationale: The proposal captures the right procedure and order (caniuse, MDN, email with the "Re: <feature> in <browser>" subject, body, discard). However, it omits the customer parameter (it uses a vague "recipient email" instead of {customer}@example.com), never says to read the browser's version from the support table, and doesn't mention closing the MDN tab. It also lists the MDN URL as an input when it is derived, and its steps are too vague to automate directly.
